title: Problem with Indian Airlines
description:
From rising airfares to emergency landings, flying in India is becoming a stressful (and expensive) experience. But why are Indian airlines suddenly so unsafe and overpriced?

In this video, we break down the turbulence in India’s aviation sector—poor maintenance, overworked crew, DGCA red flags, and budget airlines cutting corners in the name of profit. Meanwhile, ticket prices are skyrocketing, even on basic domestic routes, making air travel unaffordable for the average Indian.

Is it mismanagement, corporate greed, or just lack of accountability? We unpack it all.
